source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
An attack has the characteristics and abilities of the weapon making it, and a rule that modifies rolls for a weapon applies to that weapon’s attacks.

Modifiers or abilities that apply to an attack also apply to its weapon until the unit’s attack sequence, and every effect of those abilities, such as **[[HAZARDOUS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/hazardous)**, has been resolved.
